name: Syrian Payment Gateways for WooCommerce
author: eViral.co

sections.description:
Syrian Gateways is a premium, localized payment solution specifically designed for the Syrian market. It enables merchants to accept payments through the most popular local digital wallets: Syriatel Cash, Sham Cash, and MTN Cash.

The plugin focuses on high-end aesthetics and user experience, featuring a modern design that feels integrated and premium on any modern WooCommerce theme.

Key Features

  • Localized Gateways: Full support for Syriatel Cash, Sham Cash, and MTN Cash.
  • Premium UI: Beautifully designed instructions card with modern aesthetic effects.
  • RTL Support: Built from the ground up to support Arabic (Right-to-Left) layouts perfectly.
  • QR Code Integration: Easily upload and display merchant QR codes for faster payments.
  • Manual Confirmation: Smooth workflow for manual payment validation (On-Hold status).
  • Developer Friendly: Modular base class architecture for easy maintenance and expansion.
  • Loco Translate Compatible: Translation-ready with provided .pot and .po files.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the syrian-payment-gateways-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via the WordPress “Plugins” menu.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  4. Enable the desired Syrian gateways and click ‘Finish set up’.
  5. Enter your Wallet ID, upload your QR code, and add payment instructions.
